import sys

def decode(s):
    n = len(s)
    result = [''] * n
    index = 0
    while n > 0:
        mid = (n - 1) // 2
        result[mid] = s[index]
        index += 1
        n -= 1
    return ''.join(result)

input = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(input[0])
s = input[1]
print(decode(s))
